notes.title: 🍰 Summer, sweets, and a little sin… Welcome to Paris!
notes.content: [h3]Step into the shoes of a small-town apprentice with big pastry dreams. This summer, Paris is your playground. Whip up desserts in an iconic patisserie, impress picky customers, and unlock romantic encounters with charming locals.[/h3][p][/p][h3]But beware — living in your wealthy cousin’s mansion comes with unexpected… perks. Your skills in the kitchen lead to more than just praise… they unlock deeper (and hotter) storylines.[/h3][h3]🥐 [b]Branching Romance Paths[/b] — Meet unique girls with distinct personalities and backgrounds.
